notes.title: Patch is live!
notes.notes:
Patch Notes 12/05/2012


-The user can now select whether to display keyboard keys or controller buttons for in-game prompts as follows:
    - Boot the game
    - Select "Help & Options"
    - Select "Key Config"
    - Use either the right and left arrow keys or the directional pad on your controller to toggle the display. 
    - Hightlight "Settings" and push the "A" button on your controller or the "C" key.     


-　Players' graphical preference will now be saved upon selection and loaded when game is continued.

    - Note that you will still need to switch to Classic mode to play the classic Evil Lord 30, Princess 30, and Knight 30. You will have to switch to 
      Neo-Cartoon graphics when you wish to play the newer versions of them, which consist of one stage each. 
    
-　The bomb and Holy Grail are now assigned to the correct button.
-  Client players will now be moved to the main menu when the host quits in multiplayer. 
-  Stability improvements inlucing but not limited to:
    - Game no longer crashes when paused in Retro Mode
    - Alt-Mission 26 no longer crashes in Neo-Cartoon Mode
    - Classic Princess 30 no longer crashes in Mission 

-　Various text corrections
-  Various bug fixes.
